signature.name: VTask.extend
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> [Lattice α] -> [OrderBot α] -> [IsModularLattice α] -> [DecidableEq α] -> {a b c : α} -> (P : Finpartition a) -> (hb : b ≠ ⊥) -> (hab : Disjoint a b) -> (hc : a ⊔ b = c) -> Finpartition c

conventions.statement: The parts of VTask.extend P hb hab hc are definitionally equal to insert b P.parts.
conventions.note: b is prepended as a single new part to the existing parts of P

conventions.statement: The cardinality of (VTask.extend P hb hab hc).parts equals P.parts.card + 1.
conventions.note: Since b is disjoint from a, b cannot already be in P.parts (as P.parts covers a and b is disjoint from a and nonzero), so insertion strictly increases cardinality by one

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [Lattice α] [OrderBot α] [IsModularLattice α] [DecidableEq α] {a b c : α} (P : Finpartition a) (hb : b ≠ ⊥) (hab : Disjoint a b) (hc : a ⊔ b = c), (VTask.extend P hb hab hc).parts.card = P.parts.card + 1
